name: Prior authorization algorithms
blurb: Software that scores a request against coverage criteria before a plan will pay, in Medicare Advantage, marketplace and commercial plans, and the federal rules that now limit it.

points.desc: CMS's February 6, 2024 memo on its 2024 Medicare Advantage rule says an algorithm or AI tool may assist a coverage decision, but a tool that determines coverage from a larger data set instead of the individual patient's medical history, the physician's recommendations, or clinical notes does not comply with 42 CFR 422.101(c). A predicted length of stay alone cannot be the basis for ending post-acute care.
points.name: Medicare Advantage must decide on the individual, not the average

points.desc: Under CMS-0057-F, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid and federally facilitated marketplace plans must decide urgent prior authorization requests within 72 hours and standard requests within 7 days, give a specific reason for every denial, and publish annual metrics on approvals, denials and appeals.
points.name: Decision clocks since January 2026

points.desc: The site's compliance pages on Medicare and AI and on ACA marketplace plans and AI carry the rules, the pledge and the appeal paths in full.
